Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the recent commercial call — AuroraCloud is ready to onboard Redwood as an approved vendor. Before we can issue a first PO we need the following in your vendor record: 

- Legal entity name and VAT ID for the invoice-able entity (we have multi-entity remit for EU).
- A PDF certificate or evidence of VAT registration for the EU entity.
- Bank remittance details (IBAN + SWIFT) and confirmation of who to route credit memos to.
- Your standard invoice requirements (PO referencing format, default payment terms).

Also note our AP system requires: PO number in the invoice header, invoice PDF attached, and a single-tax-line VAT split for any EU cross-border services. Can you return a completed vendor registration form and the VAT evidence by EOD Friday 9/17?

If you prefer, copy the completed form to accounts.payable@auroracloud.com and I’ll expedite.

Appreciate it,
Simon
